VERITY 1.2.3 improves update recovery, file references, and release safety.

- The updater keeps a rollback copy until the new app starts successfully and restores the previous app if startup fails.
- Chat searches only the files you approved, sends up to 8,000 relevant characters per question, and cites exact source sections or PDF pages. Preview and refresh shared files in the conversation.
- Releases are published from a matching version tag or an explicit workflow run. Existing installer assets are never replaced.

Download the DMG, open it, and drag VERITY.app into Applications.
